quality: observation-only S5 cluster/segment/vertex and tracker-association algorithms; no truth matching
containment_proxy: pixel transverse edge fraction, last pixel plane activity, bar transverse edge energy and last panel energy; descriptive leakage indicators, not true deposited-energy containment
target_envelope: accepted geometry scintillator transverse envelope and first-to-last W slab extent; W z-slab reported separately; not an exact survey of W corner shapes; truth diagnostic, never an inference input
bootstrap: 400 accepted-family-connected chunk resamples, seed 2026; class weights normalized to each fixed scenario prior inside each resample; calibration/threshold/checkpoint uncertainty conditional
curves: complete tie-aware test ROC/PR retained as descriptive curves; all reported selections use frozen validation thresholds
interval: pointwise percentile 95%; exact Clopper-Pearson additionally for raw integer counts; no exposure or significance inference
